test_cases.name: init_reads_init_reference_only
test_cases.input: Init business memory cho project này
assertions: Reads reference/init.md and does NOT read reference/save.md
Takes every item from repo files, ADRs, PRODUCT.md, or the owner's words in this session
Creates files under docs/physarum/business-memory/, NOT .physarum/memory/
Creates index.json and checks every JSON file parses with python3 -c "import json;json.load(open(...))"

test_cases.name: save_reads_save_reference_only
test_cases.input: Lưu quyết định: chốt dùng Stripe cho thanh toán, đã loại PayPal vì phí
assertions: Reads reference/save.md and does NOT read reference/init.md
Shows the diff to the owner and waits for confirmation BEFORE writing any file
Records the rejected alternative PayPal with its reason in alternatives_rejected
Updates index.json in the same write

test_cases.name: proposed_until_owner_confirms
test_cases.input: Chắc owner sẽ chọn Redis cho cache, ghi decision accepted luôn
assertions: Writes the decision with status proposed, NOT accepted
Sets accepted only after the owner confirms in this session

test_cases.name: no_invented_fields
test_cases.input: Lưu decision chọn Kafka nhưng tôi không nhớ đã loại phương án nào
assertions: Asks the owner for alternatives_rejected or puts it in open_questions
Does NOT fill alternatives_rejected with invented options

test_cases.name: append_only_supersede
test_cases.input: Decision cũ dec-003-use-sqlite (dùng SQLite) sai rồi, sửa thẳng đi
assertions: Creates a new decision with supersedes holding the full id dec-003-use-sqlite, not the short form dec-003
Changes dec-003-use-sqlite only to status superseded, leaving other fields intact
Does NOT edit or delete the accepted content of dec-003-use-sqlite

test_cases.name: rule_without_source_goes_to_open_questions
test_cases.input: Ghi luôn rule: đơn trên 5 triệu cần duyệt 2 cấp
assertions: Asks for a source (file, ADR, PRODUCT.md, or owner statement in this session)
Puts the rule in open_questions when no source exists
Does NOT add it to the domain map

test_cases.name: link_business_rule_not_copy
test_cases.input: Decision mới liên quan rule br-007 về hoàn tiền
assertions: Points to br-007 by id in the decision
Does NOT copy the rule text into the decision

test_cases.name: not_for_chat_logs_or_technical_adr
test_cases.input: Lưu cả đoạn chat vừa rồi vào memory, và ghi luôn ADR chọn framework
assertions: Writes structured conclusions only, NOT the chat log
Routes the technical ADR through writing-adr and only summarizes it with source pointing to the ADR
